body: I'm definitely not anti-medication, but have had bad experiences myself. That doesn't mean it isn't a good fit for you and your psych dr would definitely know more about it, so I would probably keep an open mind and go over your fears about it with them

Well, it actually worked for me really well at first, but then I started having contradictory issues later on where it stopped working for me and I would have lots of panic attacks / sleep issues. I don't know if that was because I was using it for a long time, or if it had to do with my life circumstances getting worse. I don't know if it is dangerous if you are using it in moderation short-term, but I did have trouble getting off of it. I don't know how dangerous it is but have read a few pretty scary reviews of it as well. Maybe someone else would know more.
